marketing_description: The Wera Mini Snip features an offset steel blade design with a 3/4 inch length of cut and precision ground serrations for cutting galvanized steel up to 24 ga or 0.71 mm in thickness. Built with a compact 7-1/8 inch overall length, it includes a non-slip handle made of hardened steel in a multicolor finish. This tool offers durable construction and an ergonomic handle to assist trade buyers in daily metal cutting tasks.
